mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repo_relation (tenant_id, from_repo_id, to_repo_id, relation_type, description, ai_session_id, creator_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{fromRepoId}, #{toRepoId}, #{relationType}, #{description}, #{aiSessionId}, #{creatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repo_relation WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM repo_relation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM repo_relation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (from_repo_id = #{repoId} OR to_repo_id = #{repoId}) AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE repo_relation SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE repo_relation SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE (from_repo_id = #{repoId} OR to_repo_id = #{repoId}) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
